ordered.observation: the crown must read as a palm's rosette of long arching pinnate fronds with the lowest fronds drooping; the fronds are far too thin and short today (leaflet size and frond length are the first dials)
the trunk must be straight or gently leaning, never wavy, of near-constant diameter

gaps.observation: render-0's crown is a planar radial burst: shoots leave the apex in all directions at roughly constant length and remain straight to their tips, the lowest ones reaching only slightly below horizontal and none passing below the level of the crown base. reference-0 shows the outer half of each frond curving downward into a hanging skirt that overlaps the upper trunk.

Each render-0 frond is one thread-thin axis carrying short sparse specks; no grouped, angled, stiff linear leaflets and no plumose cross-section are resolvable, while reference-0/1/2 show these clearly at both distant and close range.

The render-0 trunk describes an S with an angular kink around mid-height and narrows markedly from base to crown; reference-1/2 are straight with near-constant diameter and reference-0 leans and curves smoothly with constant diameter above the basal swelling.
The render-0 trunk surface carries no leaf-base stubs, no spiral, no diamond lattice and no fibrous matting; it is uniformly smooth.
No pendent fruiting bunches, stalks or fruit are present anywhere below the render-0 crown, where reference-0 shows two to three dense orange bunches emerging among the frond bases.
render-0 foliage colour is a dark desaturated green, within the deep-green-to-grey-glaucous span spanned by reference-0 versus reference-1/2.
render-0 foliage resolves as scattered dark specks rather than a continuous foliage mass, below the density and coherence of anchor-0 at comparable framing.
